task: Existing WPF-MATURE-05-05 cumulative workspace cache validation; no new task or current write claim

finding.fact: WorkspacePanels owns useRef(new Map<string, WorkspaceLayout>()). It gets/sets an entry for every rendered task ID and never deletes or caps entries. Each entry retains tab, openDetails, expanded, selectedPath and follow, not draft text or command receipts.
finding.lifetime: Inner TaskWorkspace is keyed by taskId, but the Map is in its parent. PluginWorkspace keys by session ID; contribution renderer identity is not keyed by selected task. App keeps the panel in Activity after first visit. Therefore switching tasks can retain the Map for the plugin/session lifetime. Plugin disable or true parent unmount destroys it; this is not an immortal allocation claim.
finding.gap: MAX_RESIDENT_CONVERSATIONS=32 caps simultaneous conversation residency, not this independent history Map. A retained anchor view plus repeated opening/closing other tasks can visit more than 32 distinct task IDs without forcing plugin/session unmount. Count growth is inferred from source; heap cost, latency and actual trajectory have not been measured.
finding.existingChecks: plugin-host.browser.ts checks panel layout retention and release on explicit plugin disable, but that shown case does not cover many sequential task visits while the same plugin stays enabled.

followup: First reproduce with an isolated production-component fixture retaining one anchor view/plugin session while visiting and closing many other tasks. Keep page, per-view draft/receipt state and render identity observable; do not use DOM count as heap evidence.

Prefer pruning using the existing authoritative resident/closed view lifecycle, or an explicit bounded metadata retention policy if old layout restoration is required. Do not introduce a second resident-task authority. Preserve active/protected views and distinguish lightweight layout preference from unsent work.

Verify retained entries are bounded across repeated visits; current task layout survives allowed switches; closing a view never cancels a background task; existing protected drafts/attachments/UNKNOWN command receipts remain intact. Preserve explicit plugin-disable cleanup.
No eager detail reads or additional background projections may be introduced merely to track layout membership.

officialReference.paraphrase: Hidden Activity preserves child state and DOM while cleaning up Effects, so hiding the panel alone does not establish a memory bound.

limits: No project edits, product imports, runtime tests, heap/CPU measurement, new browser or resource grant. This strengthens the existing cumulative cache acceptance item and does not block Picker or Arc CSS.
